review.title: Alseth phage community: species references and complete Burkholderia ambiguity
review.independence_basis: A peer independently read the authored source contexts, retained primary Methods and Results, current records and historical caller. Parent independently reviewed the exact actual M5 candidate and receipt before the guarded application. The unchanged shared native engine, checker, review builder and evidence exporter have separate code reviews and mutation controls. This is self-review of the resulting partial technical correction.
review.summary: Three existing bacterial species descriptors now carry native reference correspondences and GROUNDED status. The Burkholderia cenocepacia descriptor carries the complete two-way native ambiguity without selecting a species for J2315. Stock descriptions, the virus exclusion, biological graph, source quotations and old history are preserved. This diagnostic does not newly approve the whole scientific record.
review.scope_description: Four declared bacterial taxonomy occurrences in CommunityMech:000467: three native species correspondence blocks/statuses, one complete ambiguous status/candidate list, two native inline events and the actual source/application/history/gate chain. The phage descriptor and all biological assertions remain outside the changed fields.
review.selection: One whole-record species-plus-ambiguity canary from the prepared 467/468 pair. The reviewed population is exactly one record. The five-genus PHA record 468 is excluded from this diagnostic and cannot be counted complete from this canary.
limitations: Partial technical assessment with scientific_review:false. Diagnostic completion and eight native scoped gates do not establish a full scientific review, measured source-assertion coverage, final corpus QC, generated-page integration or campaign completion.

The three species reference populations are 17191 genomes at native fraction 0.99 for Pseudomonas aeruginosa, 15884 at 1.0 for Acinetobacter baumannii and 37403 at 1.0 for Staphylococcus aureus. These are crosswalk populations, not experimental stock genomes, isolate counts, relative abundances or identity probabilities. The first native fraction is rounded and is not a unanimity claim.

The complete Burkholderia cenocepacia name route has two alternatives, GTDB:s__Burkholderia_cenocepacia and GTDB:s__Burkholderia_orbicola. No single assignment, exact assembly classification or stock renaming is inferred for J2315.

Both streptomycin-marked UCBPP-PA14 wild type and the isogenic CRISPR-KO background remain separate experimental contexts. FZ21, 13 S44 S9 and J2315 retain their source stock identities. DMS3vir remains excluded from GTDB bacterial/archaeal correspondence; the acrF1 experimental derivative does not become an additional canonical member.

Source examination was limited to the retained main-text Methods and Results passages identified in the source context, the whole current record and its historical scientific guard. No new full-paper review, supplemental reanalysis, figure-pixel inspection or stock-assembly analysis was performed for this technical successor.

Resistance categories remain phenotype-based; the receptor mutants were not sequenced. The no-phage abundance experiments remain distinct from phage effects. Competitive-release mediation and the condition-specific gLV model remain qualified, with the existing open discussions unchanged.

All five graph nodes, three directed edges, original quotations, clinical-isolation notes, culture conditions and old history remain unchanged. The historical notes about unavailable mapping data describe the earlier curation context; this successor does not rewrite those observations or imply that no mapping table exists now.

Source reporting and binding ran locally at ab770f2602416a54835b382e881c7535b5b3e576 with the recorded untracked preparation files. Actual M5 staging, application and native gates ran at frozen 9276e66296f8063522d34e553e91260fbe9f1a5f with native Python 3.13.2. Post-application receipts disclose the accepted record change and subsequent native sidecar.

The mapping table is pinned by SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd. Its mtime is not a release identifier. Native local ontology observations retain their actual stat-based provenance rather than an invented fresh full-database digest.

Native term validation is reported literally without an assertion denominator. Historical scientific callers and strict successor admission are separate follow-up controls; passing technical validators does not establish biological truth. No issue is closed by this review.

evidence.locator: Retained main-text Methods bacterial-strain paragraphs and Results resistance-classification passage; exact primary_locators in bound source metadata
evidence.summary: The source identifies the PA14 backgrounds and the FZ21, 13 S44 S9 and J2315 stocks. It separates phenotypic resistance from unperformed receptor-mutant sequencing and distinguishes phage-free abundance observations from phage effects. These passages do not classify an experimental assembly into GTDB.

The exact pinned table and unchanged native resolver return three species correspondences through exact NCBI IDs and the complete two-option Burkholderia name route. Local NCBI authority confirms the existing species ranks and labels. The reference populations do not identify the study stocks' genomes.

assessments.topic: Existing species descriptors and experimental-stock boundaries
assessments.summary: The four selected bacterial descriptors retain their source-compatible species anchors and named stock fields. The PA14 treatment backgrounds remain distinct and no phage, genotype or exact assembly is newly identified by this mapping.

assessments.topic: Three reference populations and complete two-way ambiguity
assessments.summary: The accepted native results support the three exact species-reference blocks and preserve both Burkholderia alternatives through AMBIGUOUS status. Pseudomonas fraction 0.99 is a reference majority rather than unanimity; no candidate choice or study-stock genome claim is introduced.
